title: Grateful Dead Live at Cincinnati Gardens on 1973-12-04
lineage: Dat (Sony R500) -> SEK'D Prodif Plus -> Samplitude v7.02 Professional -> FLAC

ai_review.summary: Soundboard capture of an average 1973 show with a monster Eyes of the World jam, solid Big River and Me & My Uncle, recorded cleanly by Charlie Miller.
ai_review.review: The three‑track SBD from the Cincinnati Gardens delivers clear, well‑balanced sound that most listeners praise as “masterpiece” material, though a few edits and missing sections are noted. Musically the concert sits in the middle of the 1973 curve – rough at the start, picking up with tight moments like Me & My Uncle and Big River, and peaking on an extended, rainbow‑lava Eyes of the World > Sugar Magnolia sequence.

ai_rating.rationale: Show quality averages around a 3½‑star performance with notable highlights, while the recording is generally rated good to excellent; weighted combination yields ~3.7 stars.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Crisp mix praised by reviewers (especially Charlie Miller’s transfer); a few tuning edits and a brief missing segment are noted, but overall clarity and balance are strong.

standout_songs: Eyes of the World > Sugar Magnolia
show_quality.setlist_flow: Very late start caused a rough, sluggish first set that gradually tightened; second set was shortened but featured an explosive Eyes of the World jam before winding down.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Weaves his guitar through the extended Eyes jam, delivering bright “rainbow lava” leads.
band_member_comments.Phil: Bass is highlighted as a driving force – “bombs” and steering the band during the Eyes of the World segment.
band_member_comments.Keys: Keith’s playing praised overall; noted as great on most songs despite a flubbed Stella Blue.
band_member_comments.Drums: Bill (Mickey) briefly stops during the long improvisation, then re‑enters, adding to the ebb‑and‑flow of the set.
